de: Erkunden Sie den Sutton Park, einen der größten Stadtparks Europas; achten Sie auf die freilaufenden Wildponys.
Nutzen Sie die regelmäßigen Zugverbindungen zur Birmingham New Street, anstatt ins Zentrum zu fahren.
Betreten Sie den Park am Bracebridge Pool für die schönsten Spaziergänge und einfache Parkmöglichkeiten.
Spazieren Sie über die historische High Street, um das Erbe der 'Royal Town' zu spüren.
hu: Fedezd fel a Sutton Parkot, Európa egyik legnagyobb városi parkját; figyelj a szabadon kószáló vadpónikra.
Használd a sűrűn közlekedő vonatokat a Birmingham New Street felé a belvárosi vezetés helyett.
Lépj be a parkba a Bracebridge Pool felől a legszebb sétákért és a könnyebb parkolásért.
Sétálj végig a történelmi High Streeten, és szívd magadba a 'Királyi Város' hangulatát.
ro: Explorați Sutton Park, unul dintre cele mai mari parcuri urbane din Europa; fiți atenți la poneii sălbatici care umblă liberi.
Folosiți trenurile frecvente spre Birmingham New Street în loc să conduceți în centrul orașului.
Intrați în parc pe la Bracebridge Pool pentru cele mai pitorești plimbări și parcare ușoară.
Plimbați-vă pe High Street-ul istoric pentru a simți moștenirea de 'Oraș Regal'.
en: Explore Sutton Park, one of the largest urban parks in Europe; watch out for free-roaming wild ponies.
Use the frequent train service to Birmingham New Street instead of driving into the city center.
Enter the park via Bracebridge Pool for the most scenic walks and easier parking.
The area has a rich 'Royal Town' heritage, best felt by strolling around the historic High Street.

de.name: Balti & Currys
de.tip: Besuchen Sie die indischen Restaurants entlang der Birmingham Road für exzellente Currys.

de.name: Pub Grub
de.tip: Suchen Sie nach historischen Pubs am Rande des Sutton Parks für traditionelles britisches Pub-Essen.

de.name: Afternoon Tea
de.tip: Genießen Sie einen klassischen Afternoon Tea in einem der großen Herrenhaushotels in der Nähe.

hu.name: Balti és Curryk
hu.tip: Kóstold meg a kiváló curryket a Birmingham Road indiai éttermeiben.

hu.name: Kocsmai ételek (Pub Grub)
hu.tip: Keress történelmi pubokat a Sutton Park szélén, ha hagyományos brit kocsmai ételekre vágysz.

hu.name: Délutáni tea
hu.tip: Élvezz egy klasszikus délutáni teát a közeli, elegáns kúria-hotelek egyikében.

ro.name: Balti și Curry-uri
ro.tip: Vizitați restaurantele indiene de-a lungul Birmingham Road pentru curry-uri excelente.

ro.name: Mâncare de pub (Pub Grub)
ro.tip: Căutați pub-uri istorice la marginile Sutton Park pentru mâncare tradițională de pub britanic.

ro.name: Ceaiul de la ora 5 (Afternoon Tea)
ro.tip: Bucurați-vă de un ceai clasic de după-amiază într-unul dintre marile hoteluri-conac din apropiere.

en.name: Balti & Curries
en.tip: Visit the Indian restaurants along Birmingham Road for excellent curries.

en.name: Pub Grub
en.tip: Look for historic pubs on the edges of Sutton Park for traditional British pub food.

en.name: Afternoon Tea
en.tip: Enjoy a classic afternoon tea in one of the grand manor hotels nearby.

de.name: Gracechurch Centre

de.name: High Street Boutiquen

hu.name: Gracechurch Centre

hu.name: High Street butikok
hu.tip: Sétálj végig a High Streeten a független butikokért és különleges üzletekért.

ro.name: Gracechurch Centre

ro.name: Buticuri pe High Street

en.name: Gracechurch Centre

en.name: High Street Boutiques

de.name: Blackroot Pool

hu.name: Bracebridge Pool

hu.name: Blackroot Pool

ro.name: Bracebridge Pool

ro.name: Blackroot Pool

en.name: Bracebridge Pool
en.tip: A serene lake inside Sutton Park, perfect for a peaceful walk.

en.name: Blackroot Pool
en.tip: Another tranquil spot in the park with a historic watermill background.
